query: SELECT ordinal AS "ordinal!", execution_status FROM idempotency WHERE conversation_id=$1 AND route=$2 AND ((held AND (execution_status='queued' OR (execution_status='failed' AND execution_error IN ('run_failed','run_cancelled')))) OR (execution_status='failed' AND execution_error IN ('sandbox_failed','runtime_start_failed','decision_engine_unavailable'))) ORDER BY ordinal LIMIT $3
